title: A President Refused To Shoot A Bear. A Toy Was Born 🧸
caption:
A president refused to shoot a bear and a toy was born 🧸
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1902 President Theodore Roosevelt went bear hunting in Mississippi and refused to shoot a bear his hosts had brought him. A cartoon of the moment made the front page, and a Brooklyn shop owner, Morris Michtom, was inspired to make a stuffed bear he called Teddy's Bear. Details of the hunt differ between accounts.
Did your teddy have a name? 👇
first_comment: Every teddy bear on Earth exists because of one cartoon. What was your teddy's name? 🧸👇
